infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: ASTA reads your steps and workouts from Health to verify competition results. Nothing is written back to Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: ASTA does not write data to Health.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: ASTA adds games you have joined to your Apple Calendar when you choose Add.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: ASTA can sync games you have joined with your Apple Calendar.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos to share on your ASTA profile and game summaries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save a game summary photo when you choose to share it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos for your ASTA profile and game summaries.
